evidence.detail: Exact v308 ObjectDefinition lookup/decode in rs/d/r invokes rs/c/a/a.a(ObjectDefinition,id) on the resolved definition before returning it to callers.
rs/c/a/a is stateless and exposes only two static methods taking rs/d/r plus an object id; the primary path delegates to a very large ~680-ID switch and then applies a smaller follow-up switch.

The switch cases mutate ObjectDefinition presentation/interaction state for exact object ids, including action-array replacements and additional definition fields; the class has no decoder, cache, UI or unrelated lifecycle state.

R75 already fixes rs/d/r$a as ObjectDefinitionMode and exact object-definition consumers resolve rs/d/r for scene/menu use, establishing rs/d/r as the ObjectDefinition domain that this table post-processes.

candidates.note: Descriptive exact-v308 name for the stateless hard-coded ObjectDefinition post-decode override table. No verbatim historical source identifier is claimed.
